about_the_game:
ONE GALAXY. BILLIONS OF CHALLENGERS. ONE WISH.

Riftborn is a fast-paced tactical arena roguelite set in the war-torn galaxy of the Riftbelt, where beings from across space and time are drawn into the mysterious Collector’s Trial, a challenge that promises glory, fame, or even the rewriting of fate… if you survive.

You are one of them. A Riftborn.

Pulled into a brutal, escalating championship gauntlet, you must command a growing squad of strange and powerful fighters. Every battle is a test. Every decision, a gamble. Each pickup, ally, or Summon could flip the outcome, or seal your fate.

⚔️ Core Gameplay Features

  • Tactical Brawls, Streamlined
    Short, high-stakes battles built for momentum. Think fast. Adapt faster. Survive.

  • Summon Chaos (Literally)
    Call in unpredictable allies mid-battle and collect Moonstones to unleash massive Titans capable of changing everything.

  • Training Mode That Never Ends
    Learn every unit, combo, and mechanic in a frictionless practice mode built to sharpen instincts without punishment.

🏆 The Collector’s Championship

This isn’t just survival—it’s a series.
Seven matches. One winner.
Like a championship playoff, the first to win four games takes the crown. You might sweep. You might go to Game 7. Either way, pressure builds with each round.

Most fail.
Some rage quit.
A rare few make it through—and those names echo through the Rift.

In a galaxy where death is recycled and glory is rare, the Trial has become something more than a tournament. It’s a rite of passage, a dare whispered across systems:

“Just try to win the series. We’ll see what you’re made of.”

🧩 Key Features

  • Tactical Arena Combat – Short, intense battles that reward smart timing and positioning.

  • Permadeath Pressure – Reach zero units, and it’s over. One shot to win the Trial.

  • Team Synergy – Summon strange allies, call upon Titans, and master your playstyle.

  • Rift Ledger Lore – Discover the myth of Zor Luna, the Collector’s history, and each faction’s truth.

  • Respawn Camera – Continue to observe your allies in glorious battle as you await respawn

  • Competitive AI – Opponents challenge you every match.

  • Procedural Chaos – No run plays the same. Various pickups, fights, and twists every time.

🌱 Developer Note

Crafted by a solo developer at Moonrift LLC, Riftborn isn’t a quick release, it’s a long-term project meant to evolve over years in Early Access, with the community as part of the journey.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-4160 or AMD FX-4300
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 Ti or Intel HD 4600 (integrated)
  • DirectX: Version 11

Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system

short_description: Spawn chaos, summon titans, and outlast the Collector’s Trial in this fast-paced tactical arena roguelite. Control Zor Luna, collect boosts, pull allies from the Rift, and keep your unit count alive. One team survives. The other vanishes.
